locator: I.16: final paragraphs beginning Et ideo debemus and Et ideo omnis essentia
interpretation: Bounded prose reading of the materialized Latin; no Lean declaration or mechanically verified inference is advertised. Keeps the particular-form and immaterial-substance clauses. This is Ockham’s proposed reading, not a source verification of every doctrine he assigns to the Peripatetics, and not a denial of all forms.
